overall_reason: A four-tile feature grid for a writing tool ('Write together', 'Find anything 0.2s', 'Works offline', 'Connects your tools'); one line, 'Edits on the plane merge when you land', is specific and the rest is category copy.

score.reason: T-DEFAULT-PLAN fails (a bento grid of labelled feature tiles), T-RIVAL-NAME holds for three of four tile titles, and T-PROMISE-PICTURED fails on 'Connects your tools'; T-SIGNATURE passes partly on the shared-editor tile.

findings.title: Every large decision belongs to this client
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png 'Write together', 'Find anything' and 'Connects your tools' stay true under the name of any shared-document product.
findings.after: Title each tile with what only this product does. [DATA NEEDED: the product's name and its specific features]
findings.why: Most of the grid would hold for a rival.

findings.title: Every headline promise is pictured
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the promise is pictured by three empty grey rounded squares.
findings.after: Show the actual tools it connects. [DATA NEEDED: integration names and logos]
findings.why: A concrete promise with an empty picture reads as unfinished.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png search is shown as the number '0.2s' with no query or result.
findings.before: A number standing in for the feature.
findings.after: Show one search with its result. [DATA NEEDED: a sample query and result]
findings.why: A bare number is the stand-in signature CON-005 names.

findings.title: Refuse the default plan
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the layout is the default bento: one tall tile and three stacked tiles, each with a small label and one prop, on a pale ground.
findings.before: A bento grid of four feature tiles.
findings.after: Lead with the editor tile as the one large image and set the other features as supporting lines.
findings.why: The grid is the plan a default agent would choose for 'features of a writing app'.

strengths: 'Edits on the plane merge when you land.' names a concrete situation only an offline-first editor can promise.
The editor tile shows a real line ('Beta opens to every team on May 14.') with a 'Priya' presence tag, which pictures 'Write together'.
not_investigated: T-IDEA-CARRIES: one composition only, no screens after the first.
00-contract.md is absent: visitor mode (Persuade, a feature section) and audience were inferred; no brand authority was supplied.
Motion: one static frame per width only.
